idea-plugin.name: Issue Tool Window
idea-plugin.description:
Work with GitHub issues of the current project without leaving the IDE.

The GitHub Issues tool window lists the issues of the project's GitHub.com remotes and uses the GitHub account already configured for the Pull Requests tool window.

  • Filter by status, label and assignee (including issues assigned to you) and search in title and description
  • Keep the issue list up to date in the background while the tool window is visible and get notified about issues newly assigned to you
  • Open an issue directly with #42
  • Read issue details, Markdown descriptions, comments and activity in an editor tab
  • Create and edit issues, post, edit and delete comments, close and reopen issues
  • Start new issues from the repository's Markdown issue templates
  • Add and remove labels, change assignees or assign yourself
  • Create and check out a local Git branch for an issue
  • See the issue of the current branch in the status bar and open it with one click
  • Find issues with Search Everywhere: #42 or text from title and description
  • Open #42 in code comments with Ctrl/Cmd+Click and from the Git log context menu

Source code and issue tracker: github.com/ljunker/issue-tool-window
